create_EpisodeHelper: create an EpisodeHelper instance from a habitat.Env to manage episode iteration and tracking
set_next_episode_by_index: set the next episode to run by its integer index in the episode iterator
set_next_episode_by_id: set the next episode to run by its string episode ID in the iterator
check_next_episode_exists: check if another episode exists by comparing done count against total iter episodes
increment_episode_counter: increment the done episode counter and assert it does not exceed total iter episodes
